greeting: Hot air! Real hot air! None of that fancy helium garbage!
CRIMSON FLOATMAN! I use FIRE to fly!
You want altitude? I got altitude! Dangerous altitude!
Blue uses balloons. I use PASSION! And actual fire!
Welcome to the REAL way to fly!
Hot air balloons! For hot heads! Like me!
Feel the heat! That's the burners! Also my personality!
dialog.shop_open: Hot air specials! I've got standard baskets, deluxe gondolas, and the Inferno Cruiser! Warning: may actually be on fire!
dialog.shop_prompt: Looking for thrills? My balloons are fifty percent cheaper and two hundred percent more exciting!
haggle: Prices are HOT! Just like my product!
For you? I'll throw in a fire extinguisher! Free!
Already rock bottom! I cut costs on safety!
Fine! Fifteen percent! But the waiver stays!
purchase_success: She's a bit temperamental! Like all beautiful things!
Third degree burns covered by insurance? Asking for a friend!
purchase_fail: Even hot air costs cold cash!
Come back with coin! And maybe burn cream!
rumor: Blue says my balloons are unsafe. They're EXCITING! There's a difference!
I once flew into a storm! Would not recommend! Would do again!
The sunandmoon warned me about 'falling stars.' I think they meant ME!
Heard the Remnant Vault has anti-gravity. No fire needed! Heresy!
Twins said I'd 'rise to the occasion' then 'fall from grace.' Vague!
dialog.quest_hook: I need FIRE CRYSTALS! For bigger burners! The volcano in Ember has them! Three crystals and I'll make you a balloon that'll SCARE the clouds!
dialog.quest_active: Those fire crystals burning a hole in your pocket yet? I need them!
dialog.quest_complete: THE HEAT! THE POWER! Look at these beauties BURN! Here's your reward - the Inferno Rider! Fastest balloon in the sky!
dialog.quest_reward: Inferno Rider - Speed and excitement! Minor fire hazard included!
farewell: Don't crash! The ground is LAVA! Not really! But still!
ambient_barks: Blue is for cowards! Red is for WARRIORS!
Sky's the limit! Actually, fuel is the limit!
dialog.time_dawn: Morning thermals are PERFECT! Grab a basket!
dialog.time_noon: Hottest part of the day! Best flying! Literal heat!
dialog.time_dusk: Sunset flights! Everything looks like it's on fire! Including my balloon!
dialog.time_night: Night flying by firelight! Romantic! Terrifying! Both!

party_reactions.kade: This seems... significantly less safe than Blue's.
party_reactions.nix7: Fire-based propulsion. Elevation capacity: high. Survival probability: questionable.
party_reactions.korr: There is such a thing as too much passion.
party_reactions.renna: This is a disaster waiting to happen. Fascinating.
party_reactions.suresh: Fire rises. So does reckless ambition. Both can burn.
party_reactions.sova: I'll keep my boots on the ground, thanks.
party_reactions.grit: Finally! Someone who understands that safety regulations are suggestions!
party_reactions.ashka: YES! FIRE BALLOONS! WHY DIDN'T I THINK OF THAT?!
party_reactions.senna: How many accidents have you had? I see the scars.
party_reactions.petra: Solid ground. Under my feet. Always.

relationship_dialog.stranger: First time with hot air? Sign here! And here! Initial here!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Back for more? I knew you were a thrill-seeker!
relationship_dialog.friend: My favorite lunatic! Ready to really FLY this time?
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You and me! We'll touch the sun! What's the worst that could happen?!

mini_quest.title: Crystal Inferno
mini_quest.description: Collect Fire Crystals from Ember volcano for Crimson's burners

stages.hook: I need Fire Crystals! Three of them! My burners need MORE POWER!
stages.active: Ember's volcano! Deep in the caldera! Don't get melted!
stages.complete: BEAUTIFUL! Feel that heat! Here's the Inferno Rider - she ROARS!
